services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: DIAMOND COVE SUMMER DAY CAMP 2026! Diamond Cove Summer Day Camp is open to the children and grandchildren of Great Diamond Island homeowners and other families who are renting property on the island. This year DCSDC is open to children from kindergarten through 5th grade and will offer 4 sessions from July 7th thru July 30th. Each session meets from 9:00 am-12:00pm on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday mornings. This year, our camp counselors will be a different pair each week. blurb: The Fort McKinley Museum is owned by the Diamond Cove Homeowner’s Association and operated by a committee of volunteers. Open from July-September, the museum offers exhibits on the history of Fort McKinley and also hosts several events throughout the summer.
